messages:
Marta: Heads-up, CI is red on main — audit-event validation failing after the RBAC change in PR #478. Seems to be schema mismatch for `actor.role` on KMS events.
Ryan: Ugh, saw that earlier. Which test is blowing up?
Marta: tests/audit_validation.py::test_golden_fixtures_kms - assertion: expected 'system' but got ['service_account', 'system'].
Marta: Full snippet:
```
E       AssertionError: {'actor': {'id': 'svc-123', 'role': ['service_account','system']}} != {'actor': {'id': 'svc-123', 'role': 'system'}}
```
Marta: The validator (jsonschema ajv wrapper) enforces string for actor.role currently. RBAC patch made role multi-value.
audit-bot: [automated] audit-validator job failed on commit 9c7b2a4 (PR #478). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/1234/jobs/5678
Oliver: If role can be list OR string we need the schema to accept both (oneOf) or normalize events before validation. Prefer schema change only if backwards-compatible.
Jas: Golden fixture drift likely. Recommend regenerating golden fixtures and adding a compatibility test to ensure old consumers still see string.
Ryan: Does anyone know if any customer-facing contract guarantees `actor.role` is a single string? Compliance teams asked before — maybe documented in audit-spec.md.
Marta: Checked docs — spec says "role: string" but the RBAC change intentionally introduced arrays for service accounts. Missed updating spec + validator.
Oliver: Quick plan: 1) revert validator strictness to accept string|array 2) add migration note in audit-spec 3) open follow-up to normalize emitting code in auth-service.
Jas: I can run golden fixture regen locally and push a PR with updated fixtures + a unit test that asserts both forms pass validation. Command I used:
```
./scripts/regenerate-audit-fixtures.sh --filter kms
pytest tests/audit_validation.py::test_golden_fixtures_kms -q
```
Jas: When I ran regen, a couple of other fields changed (timestamp format normalized). I'll isolate the role change into its own commit.
Ryan: Also add an ajv compatibility rule: schema v2 should accept v1 shapes. Add a small script `scripts/check-schema-backcompat.js` to CI. If it fails, block merging.
Marta: Filing two PRs: one small validator tweak (hotfix) and one spec+emit fix for the auth-service. Hotfix target: revert schema strictness to allow array OR string.
Marta: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/512 (validator hotfix)
audit-bot: [automated] linked issue #1023 (audit events compatibility) to PR 512
Oliver: For CI flakiness, let's also tag tests that require golden regen with @flake-ignore until stable. But prefer fixing rather than tagging.
Jas: I'll open the fixture PR after I finish running full test matrix. ETA ~2 hours.
Ryan: Also check any downstream consumers — notify security-comms and CS about change in case customers ingest events.
Marta: I'll draft an internal note for customers and post in #support once we know scope.
Oliver: Assigning follow-ups: Marta -> customer note & PR 512, Jas -> fixture PR, Ryan -> schema backcompat CI job. I'll own the auth-service emitter change.
Marta: Thanks. If anyone sees other failing audit tests in other suites ping here. :thumbsup:
